title: Float to Integer Truncation

content.problemStatement: Write a program to accept a float value as input from the user and print its closest integer value.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '12.345' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '98.045' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Accept a float value and truncate/cast it to an integer.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Cast the float to an integer directly, discarding fractional part as required.

hints: Convert the float value to an integer.
Casting (int) in C/C++/Java truncates the decimal portion.
In Python, int(float(s)) truncates toward zero.
learningObjectives: Understand type conversion from float to integer.
Learn difference between rounding, ceiling, and truncation.
